title: Three commercial ships struck by drones near Romania's Black Sea coast over two days
summary: Speaking at the military port of Constanța on Nov. 14, Romanian Defense Minister Ștefan-Radu Oprea confirmed that Romanian authorities had been notified of the incident and that an investigation was underway.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,622,860 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,230 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: Drone attack kills 1, injures 4 in Russia's Rostov Oblast, governor says
summary: The attack damaged two electrical substations in Taganrog, including one supplying power to railway infrastructure. A fire broke out at a substation in the city's Shubin district, while power lines between the Taganrog-Passenger and Mikhailovka railway stations were left without electricity.

title: YouTube blocks 16 Russian channels in Ukraine, including 'Masha and the Bear' versions
summary: The latest restrictions are part of a broader effort to limit Russian influence on digital platforms. In October, Ukraine's National Security and Defense Council reported that another 39 channels spreading Russian propaganda had been blocked in Ukraine or removed from YouTube.

title: Ukraine strikes major Russian petrochemical and oil refining plants, helicopter manufacturer, military confirms
summary: "Every day these plants are idle means fewer tires for the vehicles transporting ammunition to the front, fewer rubber parts for armored vehicles and aircraft, fewer raw materials for the missile industry, and less fuel for the Russian military," the General Staff said.

title: 'Fantastic female warrior' – Drone operator Rayana killed fighting Russian forces
summary: Rayana joined the army voluntarily in 2024, becoming the first woman in the Chechen Sheikh Mansur Volunteer Battalion.

title: Ukraine's embassy blames Russia for Warsaw monument graffiti, calls it bid to ‘sow hostility’ between Ukrainians, Poles
summary: Inscriptions reading "Slava UPA" ("Glory to the Ukrainian Insurgent Army"), painted in red, appeared on two monuments in Warsaw, Polish broadcaster TVN24 reported on Nov. 14.

title: Ukraine strikes Russian military airfield in Astrakhan Oblast, drone launch site in Oryol Oblast, General Staff says
summary: In Astrakhan Oblast, drones targeted the Akhtubinsk airfield, which hosts Russia's 929th State Flight Test Center, one of the country's main facilities for testing new military aircraft and weapons.

title: Starshield restrictions hamper Ukraine's ability to defend energy infrastructure from Russian drones, Zelensky says
summary: "Russian forces are targeting substations with Shahed drones. And many of these strikes get through precisely because speed restrictions remain in place for Starshield terminals along the front line and in temporarily occupied territories," Zelensky said

title: EU forces board suspected Russian shadow fleet tanker in Mediterranean, Kallas says
summary: "The EU will keep disrupting Russia's shadow fleet at sea and through diplomatic means," Kaja Kallas said.

title: Russia launches 'mass attack' on Odesa Oblast as strikes kill 4, injure 69 across Ukraine over past day
summary: Russian forces launched 132 long-range attack drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 15, including 78 jet-powered drones, the Air Force said.

title: Ukraine, EU agree on reform steps to advance accession talks in 2027
summary: The renewed push for reforms comes after the European Commission's Nov. 4 annual enlargement report praised Ukraine's progress toward EU membership while highlighting persistent shortcomings in the rule of law and anti-corruption efforts.

title: Estonia to close border with Russia after Moscow-linked sabotage attempt on drone maker
summary: The announcement followed an attempted attack on Threod Systems, an Estonian company that manufactures reconnaissance and attack drones, in the early hours of Nov. 14.

title: IIHF confirms Russia out of 2027 World Juniors, Canada to remain host
summary: The IIHF also confirmed that Canada will remain the tournament's host, with games scheduled for Dec. 26, 2026, through Jan. 5, 2027, in Edmonton and Red Deer, Alberta.

title: Prince Harry visits Lviv to support Ukrainian veterans at Invictus Games
summary: During his visit, Prince Harry attended wheelchair rugby competitions and met with Ukrainian participants, many of whom use adaptive sports as part of their recovery from war-related injuries.
